title: DevForge closure attestation
description: Minted by `devforge checkpoint attest` as uid 0 after the closure PR head is frozen (corrective-spec-002 CS-9). Stored at /var/lib/devforge/attest/<repository_identity[:32]>/<plan_id>/<checkpoint_id>.json and consumed by the validator's rule S14, which takes the closure range from it. Its own digest is recorded in the PR review, never in the attested commit.

repository_identity.description: SHA-256 over the sorted root-commit SHAs joined by LF

base_commit.description: the reviewed PR base; a proper ancestor of head_commit

head_commit.description: the reviewed PR head; HEAD or an ancestor of HEAD at validation

record_sha256.description: digest of the record blob at head_commit; the record on disk must equal it

review_reference.description: where the independent review and this document's digest are recorded
